mine: the horns of a wild ox
note: Hebrew re'em is the wild ox; the KJV followed the Septuagint monokeros (as in 23:22).
Hebrew 'i'atsekha means "I will counsel/advise you"; "advertise" in 1611 meant inform or warn, not publicise.
Hebrew pa'ate Mo'av, "the sides/temples of Moab", is probably the temples of the head (cf. Jer 48:45 "the forehead of Moab"), not the territorial corners.

kjv: until Asshur shall carry thee (Kain) away captive
mine: How long until Asshur takes you (Kain) captive?
note: Hebrew 'ad-mah is the interrogative "how long?", introducing a new clause, not the conjunction "until".
